analysis: The PR modifies only docs/architecture/inference.md. The supplied head_text units (lines 416-1232) are unchanged surrounding context; the changed range is head 1717-1843, and the supplied patch excerpt shows a new 'Native Flint' section that is truncated, so only a small part was visible. The supplied excerpt covers FlintModel layer mapping, a cbv2Prefill that omits the vocabulary projection for evaluation-only chunks, and a strict loader that rejects missing, extra or duplicate tensors and unsupported geometry. Documentation changes alter no code, authorization, attestation, encryption or billing controls. The visible text shows no loosening of the prefix-cache posture (T-041: HMAC-keyed names, 30-minute TTL, account-scoped cacheSalt), the coordinator-authored scope, or the attestation and serving-authorization boundaries (TB-011, T-053). The loader's fail-closed validation is consistent with the T-012/T-027 weight-integrity concerns, but this documents the behavior rather than adding a control. Remaining uncertainties: the rest of the Flint section (lines after about 1843 of the patch) was truncated and not examined, and the actual FlintModel code, its loader, and whether the new model_type is gated by EngineV2SupportedModels or interacts with prefix-cache/SSD checkpoint eligibility are outside the supplied evidence. I make no claim about those. No finding is warranted from the supplied text. A later pass should read the remainder of the Flint section and the Flint source if it is in the PR, specifically cache identity, weight-hash binding and prefix-cache enablement for the new architecture.
